nodes.label: PC keyboard menu control (Esc, arrows/WASD, Enter)
nodes.norm_label: pc keyboard menu control (esc, arrows/wasd, enter)
nodes.rationale: PC keyboard only drives the menu; character is played exclusively from phones.

nodes.label: Modo aproximado del menu (Esc counting fallback)
nodes.norm_label: modo aproximado del menu (esc counting fallback)
nodes.rationale: If doom.js lacks doomy_web.c the page guesses menu state by counting Esc, which desyncs because DOOM opens/closes the menu itself.

nodes.label: BSP tree rendering / environment testing
nodes.rationale: Carmack notes BSP could also have been used for line-of-sight and movement tests instead of messy line checks.

nodes.label: Twitch Plays Pokemon (2014)
nodes.rationale: Inspiration: many people controlling the same character; Doomy is a pun on dummy + this event.

nodes.label: doomy_web.c engine functions (menu state, pause, autosave)
nodes.norm_label: doomy_web.c engine functions (menu state, pause, autosave)
nodes.rationale: Without recompiling, pause does not stop DOOM, there is no autosave and menu is detected approximately.

nodes.label: Pausa general (Espacio or disconnect)
nodes.rationale: Lets remaining players retake freed controls and recalibrate when someone disconnects.

nodes.label: EMQX Broker (wss 8084, user dommy)
nodes.rationale: config.js is public on GitHub Pages so the password is readable by anyone; retained state and LWT are required features.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages hosting (https required for sensors)
nodes.norm_label: github pages hosting (https required for sensors)
nodes.rationale: Phone sensors and microphone only work over https.

nodes.label: Topic host (phones to PC: unir, elegir, soltar, listo, ping, salir LWT)
nodes.norm_label: topic host (phones to pc: unir, elegir, soltar, listo, ping, salir lwt)

nodes.label: PC input validation (only assigned keys, menu closed)
nodes.norm_label: pc input validation (only assigned keys, menu closed)

nodes.label: EMQX whitelist architecture (auth, wss, tacto/#)
nodes.rationale: Global deny rule; clients must authenticate, use wss/TLS and only publish/subscribe to authorized topics or the broker silently rejects.

nodes.label: Sensor Microfono (relative dB, Hz)
nodes.rationale: dB are relative to mic max (0 dB = saturated), vary per phone.

nodes.label: Sensor de luz (removed)
nodes.rationale: Removed because not all devices include a light sensor; microphone was added instead.

nodes.label: Conflicting controls rule (same phone)
nodes.rationale: Gestures that share tilt, shake, extra finger or microphone would trigger multiple controls at once; only one mic control per phone because a sound has both volume and frequency.

nodes.label: Touch fire on each new finger (no delay)
nodes.norm_label: touch fire on each new finger (no delay)

nodes.label: Mic frequency via spectrum peak (harmonics issue)
nodes.norm_label: mic frequency via spectrum peak (harmonics issue)
nodes.rationale: Voice harmonics can be stronger than the fundamental; whistling works better.
